rows.res: High-metallicity atmosphere with reflective aerosols; muted spectral features.

Compatible with a water-rich (steam) atmosphere; H2-dominated solutions disfavored.

CH4 and CO2 in an H2-rich atmosphere, no NH3. Possible DMS/DMDS claims are tentative and disputed; hycean vs. mini-Neptune still debated.
Hints of sulfur-bearing volatiles (SO2/H2S), volatile-rich interior. At the super-Earth/sub-Neptune boundary.
Hints of a N2-rich secondary atmosphere; not a firm detection. Candidate water world / temperate rocky planet.
Strong CH4, moderate-to-strong CO2; no significant sulfur species. Consistent with a deep H2-rich atmosphere.
CH4, CO2, H2O; metal-enriched atmosphere, consistent with a miscible envelope.
Hot sub-Neptune spectrum obtained; see Davenport et al. for the retrieved composition.
Evidence for CH4 (~1% mixing ratio) in an H2-rich atmosphere; no NH3 or HCN.
